tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Introduction to xuan-taiyishenshu, a Flutter-based Taiyi Shenshu divination system designed for precision and aesthetic appeal.

tour.title: Algorithm Engine
tour.description: The core computational heart of the system. This engine handles complex Taiyi Shenshu calculations, including year eyes, cycles, and the precise positioning of deities on the divination pan.

tour.title: UI & Themes
tour.description: Exploration of the visual presentation layer. The project features a classic ink-wash aesthetic ('Classic Theme') and a responsive layout designed to represent the traditional Taiyi Pan across different devices.

tour.title: BDD Tests
tour.description: Verification of system behavior using Gherkin features and Playwright/Flutter tests. These tests ensure that both the divination logic and the UI interactions meet the specified requirements.
